Language: English<br>

Stats: Published: 2026-10-30 Words: 1,521 Chapters: 1/1

Summary:

> The writer and artist Calogado loves making fanworks for UTAU, keeping their art and writing separate. However, they get tired of lying, and decide to reveal "utaulover123" and "utaulover456" are the same person in a 50k word fic. They enlist the help of their friend, Mayoi Heki, to make sure the reveal is perfect, but things don't turn out as planned...

[Also posted to AO3](<https://archiveofourown.org/works/95692761#main>)!

Notes:

> Idk whats wrong with me bruh. Anything except writing the shit I need to write for college. I have like a first draft essay due this week and I haven't done shit for it

Calogado was a normal person who loved to read. Fanfiction, mostly, about various UTAU and their relationships with each other. Eventually, they even began to write their own fic and gained a small cult following on the website Archive of Our Own.

They also posted their art on Twitter under a different name. Nobody knew that "utaulover123" on Twitter was the same person as "utaulover456" on AO3 ... or maybe someone knew, but never said anything about it. A double life, you might call it. When they saw discussion about their fics on Twitter, they smiled, though a bit saddened that they could not say "hey, that's me!"

Sometimes, they would get their own fic recommended to them. And all they could say was, "I'll check it out for sure!"

But they got bored of this. It wasn't fun anymore to basically lie by omission. Not only that, they wanted to create a fanfic that included their art. *Maybe I could lie and say I'm my friend, like, "thank you utaulover123 for the art in this fic!" but at that point it's less lying by omission and more of just plain lying*, they thought.

They decided to bite the bullet. At some point more people would find the similarities between utaulover123 and utaulover456, and it would become an open secret that they were one in the same. But Calogado wanted to be the one to do the reveal, not some random fan. So for the past few months, they had been working on a fifty-thousand word beast of a fanfic that included some of the best drawings they had ever done.

To make sure it was perfect, Calogado got a beta to proofread their work for the first time.

"What the hell is this?" Heki asked on a video call when Calogado sent him the document without context. Calogado was, of course, also the person who started the video call.

When thinking about who could be the beta for the fic (there wasn't a title yet besides "Deforei Fic Draft 1"), the only person who came to Calogado's mind was Mayoi Heki. Heki wasn't a writer or artist, but as a Vocaloid producer, he was intimately familiar with the Vocaloid and UTAU sphere.

Plus, Calogado knew Heki was totally into robot yuri.

"It's my fanfic. Complete with illustrations. I want you to beta it."

"I don't know if I have time to read all this. I'm kind of busy."

"Doing what? Don't you literally do nothing all day?"

"I'm trying my best, Calogado-san. Life after college is difficult, you know," he sniffled. His bottom lip quivered. "Especially when you have to keep going through it. Forever."

"I-I'm sorry, Heki, I didn't mean to—"

"No, it's fine, really." Heki covered his face with his too-long sleeves. There was a minute of Heki trying to stifle his voice and hold back tears. Calogado ended up leaving the call to give Heki some alone time.

A few days later, Heki messaged Calogado to tell them that he finished reading over their fic. They hopped on a video call again to discuss it.

"It's really good and I like the art," Heki said. "I can't believe you wrote and drew all that; you're really talented. I also like the relationship between Adachi Rei and Defoko. It's cute and evolves naturally."

"See, I knew you would say that. That's why I got you to beta this. You're my deforei guy."

"What? I've never talked about them."

"I mean, no. But you seem like the kind of guy to like that stuff. Robot yuri."

"I'm not opposed to it, I suppose. I'm confused about how you get that impression though."

Calogado shrugged their shoulders. "Anyway, is there anything I should fix about the fic? Like, continuity errors, spelling, grammar, punctuation, stuff in the illustrations?"

"Yes, I wrote down a couple of things..."

Heki and Calogado spent the next few hours discussing and fixing "Deforei Fic Draft 1." Then, when the sun started to set, "Deforei Fic Draft 1" became "Deforei Fic Draft 2."

\~\*\~\*\~\*\~

As soon as Heki woke up (he always woke up after Calogado), he and Calogado continued working on editing the fic. Heki finally suggested a real title: "Sunset."

"Their colors are like a sunset, so why don't you call it 'Sunset?'"

"You're good at titles," Calogado remarked. "I have no better ideas, anyway."

Soon, "Deforei Fic Draft 2" became "Sunset Draft 3," and over the next few weeks, drafts 4, 5, and 6 were produced.

The next round of editing would be the final one, and both Calogado and Heki were excited. Hundreds of hours of work went into it, from the writing to the illustrations to the editing. Both of them got closer, and even met up a few times in real life to discuss the fic. At the park, at a cafe, in Calogado's apartment.

Still, Calogado was most comfortable with video calls, and the final round would be a video call.

"Good morning, Heki."

"Good morning, Calogado." At some point, Heki had dropped the *san* entirely.

"I think we're almost done with the editing. There's just a few more parts at the end. When Defoko and Adachi Rei kiss for the first time — do you think the kissing was described well?"

"I don't know; I've never kissed anyone."

"Me neither."

Calogado and Heki stared at each other through the screen. Calogado's face warmed a little. Heki got uncomfortable from staring and his eyes started to dart all over the place.

"Huh… w-well!" Calogado said, breaking the silence, "Robots probably kiss way different from humans, so experience… doesn't matter in this case anyway! Let's just say it looks good and get the first chapter published."

"S-sure."

From the very beginning, Calogado planned to post the story one chapter at a time. That was one of the best things about fanfiction — you could post chapter-by-chapter instead of just posting everything, all at once. In fact, the standard was posting chapter-by-chapter. More eyes would be on your fic that way. It would also give an extra chance to fix any mistakes, but this was unnecessary for Calogado.

It had been a while since Calogado even went on AO3's website, but it wouldn't be too difficult to publish the first chapter. Luckily, AO3's interface was super intuitive.

"Hey, Heki."

"Yes?"

"Do you want me to put you as the co-author? You helped me so much that you basically wrote the fic with me."

"You don't have to if you don't want to."

"I want to."

"Go ahead, then."

"Okay." Calogado smiled. Finally, the fic was finished. It had taken so long: they started talking to Heki in late July and now it was late October. But it was worth it, because Calogado (and Heki) could finally bear the fruits of their labor.

"Um… Calogado… if you have any more fics you want me to beta, just let me know."

"I already have like fifty billion other fic ideas. Plot bunnies breed like crazy in my mind."

"Ew."

That's when Calogado opened AO3. But instead of being greeted with the normal interface, they were greeted with:

> The archive is down for maintenance.<br>
> 
> <br>
> 
> Check our status page, @status[.archiveofourown.org](<http://status.archiveofourown.org/>) on Bluesky or ao3org on Tumblr for updates.

"Wh-what? No fucking way…" they muttered under their breath.

"What happened, Calogado?"

"AO3's down for maintenance."

"Oh, well, usually, maintenance doesn't happen for too long," Heki said nonchalantly, "so we can just wait and publish it tomorrow instead."

"I checked the status page. It's down for two weeks."

"What?" Heki screamed a bit too loud, peaking his microphone.

"Around two weeks. Up to four weeks."

"You're joking."

"I wouldn't joke about this. Check for yourself."

Heki checked for himself.

"No fucking way!" His eyes widened.

"Literally exactly what I said."

"Has AO3 ever been down for that long before?"

"I don't think so. But they also said they'd put the site in a degraded state soon, so like, maybe read-only or something." Calogado was constantly hitting CTRL+R in case of new information.

"At least we weren't writing our fic on AO3's editor, and we can just publish it after AO3 comes back online."

"Yeah." Calogado sighed. "But I was so excited to get it published. I'm honestly not sure if I can physically wait that long to publish it. You know, though..."

"What?"

"The end of the story, when Defoko and Adachi Rei kiss. We have more time to work on that now."

Heki was still confused, so Calogado tried to explain as plainly as possible: "I want to kiss you, Heki."

"I want to kiss you too," Heki replied, "but what is that horrible noise I keep hearing?"

\~\*\~\*\~\*\~

A few hours later, Heki was in Calogado's apartment. They both sat on the couch, extremely nervous, and Calogado's heart strained against their chest.

*Come on, Calogado, all you have to do is...*

Calogado didn't have to do anything, because Heki pulled them in close and kissed them on the lips.

"Sorry." Heki looked away.

"What are you sorry for?" Calogado asked. "Let's do it again. For research purposes."
